newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN BONDS RETRACE EARLIER GAINS, RAND DULL.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN BONDS RETRACE EARLIER GAINS, RAND DULL.

text.p: 1007 GMT - South African bonds retrace from earlier firmer levels in moderate dealings. Rand ticks a touch weaker.

* Key R150 bond at 14.795 pct from 14.825 late Monday and a morning best of 14.715 pct. Dealers say foreigners offload some stock at strong levels, cut long positions which takes bonds back to overnight levels. Seen comfortable at current levels, expected to hold 14.75-85 pct range in afternoon. Dealers say Monday's net foreign purchase of massive one billion rand worth of bonds may be asset swap as did not move through market.

* Rand last at 4.4560/4590 on dollar from 4.4550/4580 late on Monday, despite slightly softer U.S. unit. Activity exceptionally quiet, bit of foreign profit-taking seen. Eyeing bond retracement. Range of 4.4550-4625 expected for afternoon.
